notes: Hand curation the importer cannot derive, applied by tools/import_radio_catalog.py on top of what it builds. Every entry carries a why, and each one is a judgement about a single station: a name the source mangled past any rule, a format its keyword tags do not give, or a station the directory lists twice. Rules that hold for many stations belong in the cleaners instead, not here. An id no longer in the build is an error, not a no-op: the tool says so, so a stale entry is noticed rather than silently ignored.
